On arrival at the maternity hospital, he meets his own father waiting anxiously, and when the baby arrives tells the midwife that he's its uncle. As she hands him the precious bundle the laws of physics go berserk as the long-lost time portal is thunderously re-opened and Gary finds himself catapulted into 2016. event.description: When Gary finds a row of shops blocking his route back to 1941, he decides to lease one so that he can continue to see Phoebe. He also has to decide whether to alert the Americans about the imminent attack on Pearl Harbour. Christmas special from 1995, starring Nicholas Lyndhurst and Dervla Kirwan
